page.overview:
Who is Janet?

Janet was a young girl who dressed up as a cat for Halloween. She was out trick or treating with her little brother Mark and a female friend. She had to keep watch over her brother, but lost him for a moment as he ran off while the girls were getting candy. When she found him, he was standing in front of a very tall man. She quickly grabbed her brother and told him not to talk with strangers.
